description: Electricity generation broken down by production type (solar, wind, nuclear, gas, etc.) for a country over a date range. Returns {unix_seconds, production_types:[{name, data}]}; each series' data array is timestamp-aligned to unix_seconds. Power in MW.

aggregate.description: Collapse the 15-minute readings into the mean MW and the energy in GWh per hour, calendar day or calendar month (days and months are local to the country, as Energy-Charts aligns its windows). Pass "daily" or "monthly" for any window longer than about a week: a year is 35,040 readings per series and does not fit in an answer. Omit for the raw readings.

country.description: 2-letter lowercase country code, e.g. "de", "fr", "es", "pl", or "all" for the EU aggregate.

end.description: Optional end date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

production_type.description: Keep only the series whose name contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. "offshore" (Wind offshore), "solar", "lignite", "nuclear", or several separated by commas ("wind offshore, wind onshore"). A name that matches nothing is refused with the list of names the country has. Use it for "offshore wind", "solar output", "coal generation" questions.

start.description: Optional start date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 7 days ago.

name: public_power
